name: Civic Masjid
summary: A broad semicircular dome and square minaret become one bold, cut-paper mosque.
why: The minaret joins the hall at x=36–39. The dome and central entrance share x=57, and all walls end on y=73. A vermilion side bay is an actual piece of the joined façade; every opening is a true cutout.
risk: The heavy dome and square tower feel architectural and assertive rather than delicate. The smallest side openings simplify at 24px.
sub1: Stepped cap, broad dome, shared foundation
sub2: Vermilion occupies a complete side bay
reasonToChoose: A mosque identity with the clarity of a strong editorial stamp.
